description: This file contains functions for managing random number generator states and seeds for XPU devices in PyTorch, including getting and setting RNG states, seeding, and initializing devices.

methods.name: get_rng_state
methods.description: Returns the RNG state of a specified XPU device as a ByteTensor.

methods.name: get_rng_state_all
methods.description: Returns a list of RNG states for all XPU devices.

methods.name: set_rng_state
methods.description: Sets the RNG state for a specified XPU device.

methods.name: set_rng_state_all
methods.description: Sets the RNG states for all XPU devices.

methods.name: manual_seed
methods.description: Sets the seed for RNG on the current XPU device.

methods.name: manual_seed_all
methods.description: Sets the seed for RNG on all XPU devices.

methods.name: seed
methods.description: Seeds the RNG for the current XPU device with a random seed.

methods.name: seed_all
methods.description: Seeds the RNG for all XPU devices with random seeds.

methods.name: initial_seed
methods.description: Returns the current seed of the current XPU device.
